Dear Editor, Associate Editor, and Reviewers,

Thank you for the careful and constructive engagement with our manuscript.
We are grateful for the time and thought each reviewer invested, and we
believe the revisions have substantially strengthened the paper.

Below, we first summarize the major changes, then respond to each comment
point by point. Reviewer comments appear in block quotes; our responses
follow in regular text.

## Summary of Major Revisions

1. **[First major change].** Brief description. \changed{Section~X, pp.~Y--Z}
2. **[Second major change].** Brief description. \added{New Section~X, pp.~Y--Z}
3. **[Third major change].** Brief description. \changed{Section~X, pp.~Y--Z}

---

## Response to the Associate Editor

The Associate Editor recommended acceptance after major revisions and did
not provide additional comments. We thank the Associate Editor for their
assessment.
